rules.rule: Reuse Odyssey local-map ruins and Wreckage stripped families; coordinate shared approaches if donor geometry fails. No enemy evidence/intact open prize; no alternative planet.

Native substrate stays nonfertile and a contamination source through clearing/wetting; allow buildings, roofs and imported hydroponics. Ordinary toxin/pollution paths and shared geometric Direct Sun only. Choose renewal tuning using the whole model; no new engine or heat kind.

Consecutive calm/strong-wind counters with strict gap; interruptions reset counters. Preserve seeded saved bearing. Queue fresh fall until unfinished lift completes rather than resetting or overlapping the front.

Film uses exposed walkable nonwater cells and valid neighbour screens; one shared capped grid, ordinary overwrites/eviction. Film removal by cleaning/feeding/flooring clears its trace. Disabled shells create no clean-cell exception.
Grid cursor and film wipe advance together; at most one front dose per pawn, with coupled saved cursor/bearing/hit identities. Off can finish harmless cleanup but adds no harmful pulse.

No roster eviction; ordinary feeding/weapons/products work. Consumption preserves readable remains and gear; Bones butcher hook is not eating evidence. No conjured berries. Bileworm mood aura moves independently of feeding.

Arm eligible wild scaria chatrak on Warscar only, revalidate cure/taming/death and permit onset despite blocked circling. Keep plate/feeding/movement warnings. Biome lookup is independent of disabled mark gameplay.
Sound uses actual enabled local sources; wind stops in fall. Broken-gun tracking has no firing verb. Dry aerosol wording and UI remain readable; absent extra sources make no sound.

Gate moved creation/effect/reward routes off by default while defs and shared APIs persist. Neighbour screens retain their own broad contracts; unsupported opt-in remains off. All-off ends local scripted hazards gracefully and effect timing is labelled.

meetings.why: Native poison, falling aerosol, lift and external screens can double-dose or cancel each other and erase forage; attribute sources before tuning.
Current extras are mostly default on and not all routes obey their comp toggle; shared service must survive local gating. Enumerate creation, reward and off/on transitions.
Seeding, roach/cleaner removal, capped recording, wind wipe and reload share substrate and grid; model all consumers and capacity boundaries, not a filmed example strip.
Terrain sterility, renewable poison, growth exclusions and construction/food-web survival may conflict; label-only reasoning cannot settle the playable region.
Higher-order loop: toxin changes forage/deaths, body eaters change food/filth, roaches erase film and grazer rage adds deaths. Pairwise feeding success does not establish seasonal persistence.
Health/UI, dry dust, corpse remains and actual source sound name different causes; W8 judges combined presentation and W9 catches attention floods. No sound is the sole warning.
Stripped works and harmless tracking supply ordinary land without manuals/hospice/rings; align ordinary layout instead of adding encounters. Live composition still owed.
